title: Delos Data, a chip startup founded by Intel veterans, raises $100 million for AI networks
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

Delos Data, a semiconductor startup founded by former Intel executives, has raised $100 million to develop chips and software designed to improve the flow of data inside artificial intelligence systems.

The funding underscores growing investor interest in the less visible infrastructure behind AI. While graphics processors provide the computing power used to train and run models, those processors must continuously exchange information with memory, storage and other chips. Slow or inefficient connections can leave expensive hardware idle, increasing both electricity use and operating costs.

Delos Data aims to address that bottleneck with flexible networking technology capable of connecting different types of AI hardware. Its approach could become increasingly important as data centers move beyond systems built primarily around Nvidia processors and incorporate chips from AMD, Cerebras Systems and other suppliers. By supporting a broader mix of components, Delos hopes to help operators build faster, more adaptable networks without being tied to a single computing platform.

Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer Dan Daly said the company is focused on moving information rapidly as AI infrastructure evolves. The opportunity is significant because modern AI workloads depend not only on raw computing performance but also on how efficiently thousands of processors work together.

he financing round drew backing from Matrix Partners, Playground Global, Socratic Partners, Capricorn Investment Group, Matter Venture Partners, IAG and DYNAMIQ. Former Intel chief executive Pat Gelsinger, now a partner at Playground, also invested. He argued that poor communication between chips creates substantial energy and financial waste.

With the fresh capital, Delos enters a fiercely competitive market shaped by soaring data-center investment and demand for alternatives to proprietary networking systems. Its challenge will be translating its architecture into reliable products that major cloud providers and AI developers can deploy at scale across increasingly large and complex computing environments worldwide today.

Reuters — “Delos Data, a chip startup founded by Intel veterans, raises $100 million for AI networks”, September 15, 2026. Primary source for the funding amount, investors, founders and market context.
